# International Council for Media Literacy

> > The oldest continuous media literacy organization in the USA, IC4ML connects professionals, educators, and the public through awards, publications, and advocacy for critical media engagement.

IC4ML (International Council for Media Literacy) has been advancing media literacy education and practice since 1953. The organization publishes the Journal of Media Literacy, administers prestigious awards recognizing contributions to the field, and convenes annual conferences bringing together media literacy professionals and advocates.

- [Jessie McCanse Award Recipients](https://ic4ml.org/awards/the-jessie-mccanse-award/the-jessie-mccanse-award-recipients): Jessie McCanse Award recipients from 1987 to present
